versions.content: Initialization and Shutdown Description: Remote Persistency shall support initialization and shutdown. Additional Information: As a daemon, Remote Persistency is started and stopped according to the configuration of run levels by the Execution Management. This mechanism helps Remote Persistency to prepare and clean up its environment in order to ensure a reliable behavior. E.g. the available storages need to be opened before they are accessed via the service interface. And before shutdown, all data of Remote Persistency needs to be persisted.
